product: Foam baby play gym (ג'ימבורי) set: climbing steps, tunnel cube, slide ramp, round pouf, from the brand Bliss (@bliss.il); caption also mentions a ball pit and a tent and tunnel
disclosure_visible: caption: 'בשיתוף @bliss.il'; coauthor bliss.il in media info; paid-partnership label 0 (not set). No disclosure text burned into the video frames.
format: mom-and-baby home demo with burned-in subtitles and voiceover, showing assembling, rearranging and packing away the product

hook_0_3s.opening_image: Wide shot of a bright living room with sheer curtains; a mom sits on the floor holding a baby on her lap and touches the round hole of a beige foam cube next to a ramp
hook_0_3s.spoken: machine transcript 0.0-5.7 s: 'התחלת לאם מאוהבת בג'ימבורי, ואיך שראיתי את הג'ימבורי של בליס, ידעתי שאני חייבת כזה לבית' (the first word is a mishearing of the baby's name)
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: Headline text, top of frame, 0-3 s: 'פוב הבת שלך מאוהבת בג״מבורי אז דאגת שיהיה לה גם בבית'. Lower subtitle line changes word by word, e.g. 'ואיך שראיתי' at 2 s.
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: a 'POV' line addressed to the viewer as a parent whose child loves the product, plus a visible baby, which invites parents with a baby to keep watching.

how_value_is_shown: Subtitles and voiceover list the benefits (colours that fit any room, easy to clean, good for development, rearrangeable, stackable for storage) while the footage shows a baby crawling, climbing and hiding in the tunnel and mom rearranging and stacking the pieces.
demonstration: Baby climbs the steps, crawls through the tunnel hole, leans on the cube; mom lifts, rearranges and stacks the pieces
proof: A baby about 8 to 12 months old using the product on camera; an adult sitting on the steps; pieces being moved and stacked by one person. No cleaning demonstration is visible although 'easy to clean' is claimed.
emotion: Warm, calm, soft; the creator sounds enthusiastic in the transcript and the baby crawls happily (as seen in frames)
personal_story: Short: the creator says the baby loves the play gym and she wanted one for home after seeing the brand's version; she says she separates the pieces because the baby gets excited about it.
selling_language: 'ג'ימבורי איכותי שיעסיק את הבייבי' (caption); 'מושלם להתפתחות של הבייבי' (machine transcript); 'כנסי עכשיו לאתר של בליס ותודי לי אחרי זה' (caption)
captions_on_screen: Headline text at the top for the first seconds, plus burned-in word-by-word subtitles of the voiceover at the lower middle, white sans-serif, with the current word highlighted; one emoji (pointing down) in the last subtitle.
editing_rhythm: About 14 detected cuts in 28 s, average shot about 2 s; many are continuous wide static takes in the same room; no obvious speed ramps; a few jump cuts between arrangements.
ending_and_cta: Last subtitle: 'כל הפרטים בתיאור' with a pointing-down emoji while mom stacks the pieces. Caption CTA: go to the Bliss website now and thank me afterwards. No comment word or code.
convincing: Interpretation: a baby visibly playing with the set in an ordinary living room, one adult handling the pieces alone, and the long uncut takes feel like real home footage rather than an ad.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the claims 'easy to clean' and 'colours' are only spoken and not shown; no price or code; the brand name is not shown on any object in the frames; the headline wording is hard to read as one sentence on first view.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a 'POV, your child loves X so make sure she has it at home' headline over a calm static wide shot, with a voiceover and word-by-word subtitles recorded afterwards, can be done on a phone on a tripod. LumeBook could do the same with a child flipping through the personalised book at home, and say the benefits in the voiceover while showing them.
solo_without_child: partly: the voiceover, subtitles and packing-away section can be filmed alone, but the core proof is the baby using the product
not_verified: Brand name is not visible on the product in the frames (it comes from the caption and the coauthor). Price and discount terms are not stated. Whether the music plays was not determined. Age of baby is an estimate from the frames.
